entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie. I... I have a VeloBand Pulse, and I think I need to return it. I'm not sure what to do.
I can certainly look into that return for you. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, um, I don't think it's broken. It's just... a lot. I thought it would be simpler, and I'm feeling a bit overwhelmed by it all. I'm just not using it. Can't you just help me?

Of course, I can help. It sounds like it just wasn't the right fit for your needs, and that's perfectly okay. Let me just pull up your order details. Can I get your full name and order number, please?
Yes, the name is Sarah Jenkins. The order number is VF-8675309.
Thank you, Sarah. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor. It was delivered 18 days ago. Let me quickly review our return policy for you.
Okay... I just hope it's not a problem.
Alright, I've got it pulled up. And I have some good news for you. Our policy states that items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery, so you are well within that timeframe.
Oh, really? Ninety days? That's amazing! I was so worried I had missed the window. That's such a relief.

Not at all. I'm processing the return authorization for you right now. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email address on file. You can just print that out, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any post office.
That is so easy. Thank you, Charlie, you've been a huge help!

It's my pleasure. And I also see you're a VIP member with us. To thank you for your loyalty and for giving our new product a try, I've added a $20 credit to your VeloFit account for any future purchase. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Wow, no, that's really generous. That's everything. Thank you again!
You are very welcome, Sarah. Have a wonderful day, and thank you for calling VeloFit.
